title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for type 1 diabetes and polyneuropathy.

HPI
The patient is a 54-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of type 1 diabetes mellitus. He reports stable glucose management and continues to use insulin as his primary treatment. He denies any new symptoms regarding his peripheral neuropathy but notes occasional tingling in his toes. He has been on the same insulin regimen for several years and reports consistent adherence.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Physical exam reveals diminished sensation to monofilament testing in bilateral feet. Muscle strength is intact in lower extremities. Skin is intact with no signs of ulceration.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus
2. Polyneuropathy

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. Patient will continue to monitor blood glucose levels daily. We will monitor the progression of his polyneuropathy. Follow up in three months for a repeat evaluation.
explanations: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: E10.42.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Coding separately misses the presumed link.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
